meta.name: Omada incident type titles and definitions
meta.source: Omada controller web UI bundle (version per README). Extracted from the Settings-page incident dictionary (title + content), not from the longer analysis-view templates.
meta.note: {SITE} and {SITE_LOWER} are UI i18n placeholders for the word “site”, not a site name or ID.

entries.title: AP frequently offline
entries.content: Within 1 hour, the AP goes offline %offlineCount% or more times.

entries.title: APs on {SITE_LOWER} going offline in batches
entries.content: When the total number of online APs is ≥ 6, the average number of APs going offline within 1 hour is ≥ %avgDisconnectCount%, the percentage of offline APs is ≥ %disconnectApPercent%%, or the number of offline APs is ≥ %disconnectCount%.

entries.title: AP receiving weak mesh signals
entries.content: Within 15 min, the percentage of AP RSSI samples at or below %threshold% dBm is ≥ %count%%.

entries.title: Uplink AP offline
entries.content: Uplink AP is offline.

entries.title: Uplink AP disconnected and device out of range of other APs
entries.content: The uplink AP is disconnected, and the device is not within the detection range of other APs.

entries.title: Mesh AP isolated
entries.content: Mesh AP is in the Isolated state.

entries.title: Client association failure
entries.content: The client association failed.

entries.title: Client frequently offline
entries.content: Within 15 min, the client goes offline %offlineCount% or more times.

entries.title: Low client association success rate
entries.content: Within 1 hour, the number of client associations is ≥ 8, and the association success rate is ≤ %threshold%%.

entries.title: Client authentication failure

entries.title: Low client authentication success rate
entries.content: Within 1 hour, the number of client authentications is ≥ 8, and the authentication success rate is ≤ %threshold%%.

entries.title: Low AP client association success rate
entries.content: Within 1 hour, the number of associated clients under the AP is ≥ 8, the total number of associations is ≥ 8, and the success rate of all association events is ≤ %threshold%%.

entries.title: Low AP client authentication success rate
entries.content: Within 1 hour, the number of authenticated clients under the AP is ≥ 8, the total number of authentications is ≥ 8, and the success rate of all authentication events is ≤ %threshold%%.

entries.title: Abnormal client disconnection
entries.content: The client disconnected abnormally.

entries.title: Client failed to connect
entries.content: The client connection failed.

entries.title: Client slow to connect

entries.title: Client failed to obtain IP

entries.title: Client slow to obtain IP

entries.title: Low AP client roaming success rate
entries.content: Within 1 hour, the successful roaming rate is ≤ %threshold%%.

entries.title: Client ping-pong roaming
entries.content: Within 5 min, the client roams between different bands of one AP or different APs %threshold% or more times.

entries.title: Client roams frequently
entries.content: Within 1 hour, the client roams %threshold% or more times.

entries.title: Client roams slowly
entries.content: Within 1 hour, the percentage of all client roaming times exceeding %duration% s is > %threshold%%.

entries.title: Client sticky roaming
entries.content: The client is unable to roam.

entries.title: Abnormal AP reboot
entries.content: The AP rebooted abnormally.

entries.title: AP temperature too high
entries.content: Within 10 min, the device's temperature is too high.

entries.title: Client SNR exception

entries.title: AP channel utilization too high

entries.title: Client negotiation rate exception

entries.title: Client negotiation rate distribution exception
entries.content:
Within 15 min, on the 2.4 GHz band, the percentage of the samples of the client's normal negotiation rate under the AP is ≤ %count2g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz band, the percentage of the samples of the client's normal negotiation rate under the AP is ≤ %count5g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz-2 band, the percentage of the samples of the client's normal negotiation rate under the AP is ≤ %count5g2%%.
Within 15 min, on the 6 GHz band, the percentage of the samples of the client's normal negotiation rate under the AP is ≤ %count6g%%.

entries.title: Client interferes with low negotiation rate
entries.content:
Within 15 min, on the 2.4 GHz band, the client negotiation rate is abnormal, the throughput is ≥ %throughput2g% Mb, and the channel utilization rate of this band is ≥ %util2g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz band, the client negotiation rate is abnormal, the throughput is ≥ %throughput5g% Mb, and the channel utilization rate of this band is ≥ %util5g%%.
Within 15 min, on the 5 GHz-2 band, the client negotiation rate is abnormal, the throughput is ≥ %throughput5g2% Mb, and the channel utilization rate of this band is ≥ %util5g2%%.
Within 15 min, on the 6 GHz band, the client negotiation rate is abnormal, the throughput is ≥ %throughput6g% Mb, and the channel utilization rate of this band is ≥ %util6g%%.

entries.title: Client signal strength distribution exception
entries.content:
Within 15 min, less than %ratio2g%% of clients on the 2.4 GHz band have a signal strength between %lowerThreshold2g% dBm and %upperThreshold2g% dBm.
Within 15 min, less than %ratio5g%% of clients on the 5 GHz band have a signal strength between %lowerThreshold5g% dBm and %upperThreshold5g% dBm.
Within 15 min, less than %ratio5g2%% of clients on the 5 GHz-2 band have a signal strength between %lowerThreshold5g2% dBm and %upperThreshold5g2% dBm.
Within 15 min, less than %ratio6g%% of clients on the 6 GHz band have a signal strength between %lowerThreshold6g% dBm and %upperThreshold6g% dBm.
